description: Conversion of garage to habitable room
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (S01, S02, S03 & S04, received on 15/04/2019;
D01A, D02A & D03A, received on 17/05/2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The converted outbuilding the subject of this permission shall not be used for purposes other than those specified on the plans hereby approved or such uses which are incidental to the application property, for the avoidance of doubt the building shall not be used as a living room, bedroom, kitchen or as a separate unit of accommodation
